page: Microsoft Azure E48bds_v6 is an enterprise memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an x86_64 Intel processor and executed under Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provisions 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 384.0 GB of system memory, delivering a memory density of 8.0 GB per virtual processor core. There are no discrete GPU accelerators integrated into this hardware configuration.

Local storage capacity is supplied via 2,832 GB of high-speed NVMe SSD media, supporting low-latency local disk input and output operations. The instance architecture is engineered for elevated block storage performance and accommodates Azure Premium Storage extensions. Network configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating standard virtual networking resources for external accessibility.

The 1:8 core-to-memory distribution coupled with large local solid-state storage delivers balanced cost efficiency for operational workloads requiring high memory capacity and rapid temporary caching without paying for extraneous graphical acceleration components. Microsoft Azure E48bds_v6 is suited for large relational databases, in-memory key-value data stores, distributed extract-transform-load jobs, and memory-heavy enterprise application serving.
